newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba Corp to launch interactive TVs.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba Corp to launch interactive TVs.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Thursday it would launch new television sets and other home appliances on October 1 to be used in Japan's first commercial interactive broadcasting system.
The company is introducing two types of wide-screen TV with built-in tuners, a VCR and a separate tuner.
The equipment gives viewers access to such interactive television services as telephone shopping and direct participation in quiz shows, Toshiba said in a statement.
Broadcasters are slated to start interactive services in November.
The system is promoted by a consortium of 45 firms including Toshiba, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd and Sony Corp.
Toshiba said that its new interactive televisions would be the first of their kind marketed in Japan.
